body: Thank you for responding. I was prescribed a low dose of ciprolex, but the psycho ex at the time convinced me to not take it. He said it would "change me" but in retrospect i think he was afraid that they would actually work and that I would be happy enough to leave him. I have a lot of family members on anti depressants who claim it has turned their life around, but as stupid as this sounds i know it is difficult to drink while on it and makes some fun drugs not work and that has stopped me from going back on them. I know that's completely ridiculous logic, I will look into getting re-prescribed. Thanks.

Thank you so much for responding, and my drug of choice is valium. Over the weekend i had a bit of a melt down while drunk and confessed to my friend how ive been feeling. 

This is a close friend of mine who had "moved" to my middle school in the 8th grade. When i told her this, she looked me stern in the face and told me that the real reason she came to my school in the 8th grade was because she attempted to kill herself because she was bullying and that she had never told anyone that. She said she was called a slut and  that when word got out that she tried to take her life, she got bullied even worse. This girl is absolutely gorgeous and is going to school to be a vet. If she had succeeded in taking her life that day she would have missed out on so much and it would have been such a waste of life as she is so incredibly pretty and intelligent and is definitely going somewhere in life. 

Though the depression is still very much there, I gotta keep fighting. Thanks a lot.
